metricDefinitions.name: evaluations.real
metricDefinitions.description: Number of evaluations of the real optimisation function.

metricDefinitions.name: evaluations.surrogate
metricDefinitions.description: Number of predictions of a surrogate model.

metricDefinitions.name: linkage-children-correlation-1
metricDefinitions.description: Number of children of recombinations in the iteration that the correlation 1 of 'x:0' and 'x:1' (0.8) applies to.

metricDefinitions.name: linkage-preserved-correlation-1
metricDefinitions.description: Number of these children that preserve the correlation 1 of 'x:0' and 'x:1' (0.8) after the recombinations: all its features have the values of one parent.

metricDefinitions.name: linkage-preserved-before-correlation-1
metricDefinitions.description: Number of these children that preserve the correlation 1 of 'x:0' and 'x:1' (0.8) before the first linkage step of their pair.

metricDefinitions.name: linkage-children-correlation-2
metricDefinitions.description: Number of children of recombinations in the iteration that the correlation 2 of 'x:0' and 'k:0' (-0.6) applies to.

metricDefinitions.name: linkage-preserved-correlation-2
metricDefinitions.description: Number of these children that preserve the correlation 2 of 'x:0' and 'k:0' (-0.6) after the recombinations: all its features have the values of one parent.

metricDefinitions.name: linkage-preserved-before-correlation-2
metricDefinitions.description: Number of these children that preserve the correlation 2 of 'x:0' and 'k:0' (-0.6) before the first linkage step of their pair.

metricDefinitions.name: linkage-children-correlation-3
metricDefinitions.description: Number of children of recombinations in the iteration that the correlation 3 of 'x:1' and 'k:0' (0.3 in [0.0, 5.12] x [-5.0, 0.0]) applies to.

metricDefinitions.name: linkage-preserved-correlation-3
metricDefinitions.description: Number of these children that preserve the correlation 3 of 'x:1' and 'k:0' (0.3 in [0.0, 5.12] x [-5.0, 0.0]) after the recombinations: all its features have the values of one parent.

metricDefinitions.name: linkage-preserved-before-correlation-3
metricDefinitions.description: Number of these children that preserve the correlation 3 of 'x:1' and 'k:0' (0.3 in [0.0, 5.12] x [-5.0, 0.0]) before the first linkage step of their pair.

propertyDefinitions.name: operators
propertyDefinitions.description: The recombinations and mutations that changed the child, in their order.

propertyDefinitions.name: changed-features
propertyDefinitions.description: The features whose genes differ from the parent whose place the child takes.

propertyDefinitions.name: primary-features
propertyDefinitions.description: The features that a 'correlation-aware-mutation' changed itself.

propertyDefinitions.name: propagated-features
propertyDefinitions.description: The changes that a 'correlation-aware-mutation' propagated to correlated features, e.g. 'x:2 from x:1 (0.9)'.

propertyDefinitions.name: linked-features
propertyDefinitions.description: The features that a 'linkage-crossover' took from the same parent as a correlated feature or a feature of the same building block, e.g. 'x:2 with x:1' or 'x:7, x:12 with x:0'.
